description: This file defines the XmlStringMatcher class, which extends BodyMatcher<String> and provides functionality to compare XML strings for similarity, including handling of differences and logging.

classes.name: XmlStringMatcher
classes.description: A matcher class for comparing XML strings for similarity, with logging and difference evaluation.

methods.name: XmlStringMatcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the matcher with a string or NottableString, setting up the DiffBuilder for XML comparison.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the provided XML string matches the expected XML, optionally with a context for differences.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Determines if the matcher is blank or null.

methods.name: fieldsExcludedFromEqualsAndHashCode
methods.description: Returns fields excluded from equals and hashCode methods.
